cohort: The study included 238 gamete donation cycles from 2011 to 2021, focusing on pregnancies resulting from these cycles in recipients at the Public Gamete Bank of CMIN, ULSSA.
finding: Pregnancies resulting from gamete donation via ART cycles showed a high incidence of adverse obstetric and neonatal outcomes, including preterm delivery, low birth weight, and multiple gestations.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were a common outcome, occurring in 47.7% of pregnancies resulting from sperm donation.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in 29.3% of singletons and 69% of twins from sperm donation, and 43.4% of pregnancies from oocyte donation.
gest_age: Preterm deliveries occurred in 29.4% of sperm donation cases and 40% of oocyte donation cases.
